items.question: What is the AEO Library?
items.answer: The AEO Library is a collection of short, practical articles on Answer Engine Optimization: what AI engines cite, how to measure your share of the answer, and how to win it. Each article is its own page so AI assistants can reference it directly.

items.question: How often is new content added?
items.answer: New articles, talks and episodes are added regularly, drawn from ongoing experiments and Bjorn's LinkedIn content.

items.question: Can I use these insights for my own brand?
items.answer: Yes, the Library is free to read. To see how your specific brand shows up in AI answers, register your interest and run the AI Answer Index.
